grid.note: index = age in Ma, 0 (today) to 750; null where a series has no value

co2_model_ppm.what: the CO2 the climate model was run with (ExperimentInfo.xlsx, scotese_07), a model input and not a proxy fit; draw it where co2_ppm is null

co2_ppm.band95: not shipped (its lower edge is negative in the rows counted above)
co2_ppm.lo68_rule: lower 68 % edge clipped at 0 ppm; lo68_clipped_ma lists the grid ages it touched
co2_ppm.what: LOESS fit to proxy CO2 (probability maximum) with its 68 % band

land_pct.what: share of the globe above sea level (PaleoDEM z > 0 m)

sea_level_m.band_rule: draw the band between the lower and the higher of min and max: the columns are not ordered bounds at every age (min_above_max_ma)
sea_level_m.what: tectono-glacio-eustatic global mean sea level relative to today

shelf_pct.what: share of the globe under shallow sea (PaleoDEM -200 < z <= 0 m)

temperature_c.what: climate model global mean annual air temperature 1.5 m above the surface (HadCM3L, suite scotese_07), area-weighted
